sections.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: bo7hacks.org is a Windows PC store for BO7 Hacks, Black Ops 7 HWID Spoofer, and Black Ops 7 Unban Tool. The cheat and UGC are $35 for 30 days or $150 lifetime. The HWID spoofer is $50 for 30 days or $150 lifetime. A lifetime key on the cheat does not include the spoofer or the recovery workspace. Starting on a month does not promise a credit toward lifetime.

Product names on this site identify what we sell. They are not a claim that the game publisher endorses the software. Delivery is a portal download for Windows 10 or 11. You keep HVCI, core isolation, TPM, and secure boot on, then open the loader only when the site still matches the current client.

sections.heading: What we publish
paragraphs: The [BO7 Hacks](/product/bo7-hack/) page lists the menu names and the Windows requirements: Windows 10 or 11, Intel or AMD, with HVCI, core isolation, TPM, and secure boot left on. The [products page](/products/) is where you compare the cheat, the [Black Ops 7 HWID Spoofer](/product/spoofer/), and [Black Ops 7 Unban Tool](/product/ugc/).
The [forum](/forum/) contains example discussions about Black Ops 7 features and gameplay, each connected to a blog guide. Read the [terms](/terms/) before checkout. Sales are final, including bans.

RICOCHET can still act on an account. Nothing here is a guarantee that a session stays clean after the next patch. Check this site after a client update before you open the loader. If the page is not current for that build, leave the software closed.

The [status page](/status/) shows the PC build and whether the loader is Ready, Updating, or Paused. Check the listed version after a game patch. Compatibility can change, and the status badge does not guarantee protection from account restrictions.

sections.heading: Support
paragraphs: Loader errors, a key that will not move, and checkout questions go through the [support page](/support/). Include your order ID from checkout, Windows version, and the exact loader text. Do not turn HVCI, core isolation, TPM, or secure boot off because a chat message from another game said to.

Before opening a ticket, check which product and plan appear on your receipt. A delivery question, a loader error, and an account restriction need different information. Include the time the issue started and the exact message you saw. Keep passwords, payment details, and license keys out of public channels.
